read: GitHub REST check-runs API at each head sha, filter=all, every page (never the status rollup); failed steps from the jobs API, caller workflow paths and events from the runs API, failure annotations from the check-run annotations API, CI Summary named blockers from the CI Summary job's own final report, companion state from the evidence stamp on the PR body, the onex_change_control PR's created, merged and closed times, and the newest occ-autobind outcome check-run. Quota was read from response headers only.

labelling_rules.blocking_check: A check blocks when it is a required context of the base branch, or when a red CI Summary names it. Non-required checks that nothing names do not decide a verdict.
change_control_checks: occ-preflight / eligibility (every caller copy, including call-reject-skip-token / occ-preflight / eligibility)
CI Summary when it is red only because of the checks above and the gates skipped or refused behind them
labelling_rules.caller_changed_on_base: The workflow file of the check's run changed on the base branch between the head's merge base and the last base commit before observed_at.
labelling_rules.precedence_meaning: The first verdict in this list whose condition holds over the blocking checks is the head's verdict. product_failed: a blocking check failed on the PR's own content. behind_required: the base is strict and the head is behind it. change_control_open: the companion has not merged (none, open, conflicting, closed or declined) and a blocking change-control check is red or running. pending: a blocking check has not completed. stale_caller_pin: every remaining red is re-runnable but its caller workflow changed on the base, so a re-run replays the old caller. change_control_stale: every remaining red is change control and the companion has merged. timed_out, runner_infra, cancelled: the remaining red timed out, failed on the runner or its environment, or was cancelled.
labelling_rules.rerun_checks: Set only for change_control_stale, timed_out, runner_infra and cancelled: the names of the blocking checks whose newest copy is red, sorted.

timed_out.measurement: Across 437 public product-repo PR heads committed on 2026-09-26 and 200 onex_change_control heads, no blocking check timed out on a head whose caller workflow was unchanged. Actions reports a job-level time-out as conclusion cancelled with the annotation 'The job has exceeded the maximum execution time'; the only such copy that day is a non-required dev-push job. The fifteen CI Summary copies that failed at their 90-minute poll deadline (omnimarket only) all ran on heads whose ci.yml had changed on dev since the merge base, and re-runs of the same runs timed out again, so they are labelled stale_caller_pin.

runner_infra.measurement: No blocking check failed on the runner or its environment without a higher-precedence red on the same head. The runner-side reds found (a JUnit artifact download that failed three times, a harness image pre-pull, a self-hosted checkout that could not resolve api.github.com) each sat beside a product failure or an unresolved companion, or were not blocking.
